profile.name: STX自动微孔板培养箱
profile.description: 一种用于微孔板样品培养与暂存的自动化培养箱，支持温度、湿度、二氧化碳和氮气环境控制，并可通过左右料盒/仓位进行微孔板进出库操作，常用于细胞培养、活细胞实验和自动化生物实验流程。
profile.description_en: An automated incubator for culturing and storing microplates, with control of temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen atmosphere. It supports plate loading and unloading through left/right cassettes or storage levels, and is commonly used in cell culture, live-cell assays, and automated biological workflows.

An automated incubator for culturing and storing microplates, with control of temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen atmosphere. It supports plate loading and unloading through left/right cassettes or storage levels, and is commonly used in cell culture, live-cell assays, and automated biological workflows.
